landingPage.header: Going electric starts with understanding your needs
landingPage.headerDescription: We need to understand your requirements so we can recommend the appropriate vehicle, charger and identify incentives.
landingPage.rightText: See how much you can save
landingPage.alertMessage: Looking to replace your existing Fossil Fuel Fleet? See how much you can save by electrifying your fossil fuel fleet, available as a guest user

projectType.title: How Do You Want To Electrify?
projectType.subMessage: Select which of these scenarios apply to you

default.subMessage: We use this information to calculate fuel costs and applicable incentives.
default.organizationTypeTooltip: Your selection from this list will be used to determine incentive eligibility
default.projectLifetimeTooltip: Project lifetime is the amount of time you plan to operate the vehicles and/or charging infrastructure. This value is used to calculate your TCO analysis over the life of the project.
default.zipcodeTooltip: The zip or postal code of your project will be used to determine electricity pricing and potentially identify incentives.
default.justice40CommunityMessage: Zip code includes a Justice 40 community, eligible for additional federal incentives. Check the box to indicate your site is within a Justice 40 community. Justice 40 Qualifications
default.dacMessage: Zip code includes a disadvantaged community, eligible for additional state incentives. Check the box to indicate your site is within a disadvantaged community. Disadvantaged Community Qualifications
default.alertMessage: Increased incentive amounts provided for DACs (Disadvantaged Community) and Justice 40 may vary by program and eligibility.

default.subMessage: Select your first vehicle. If you select a Fossil Fuel vehicle, an EV replacement will be selected for you. You can choose to remove EV chargers from your analysis if they are not relevant to your scenario. If you do not want to include vehicles in your comparison, please create a new project and select a different project type.
default.alertMessage: If operating multiple vehicles over varying distances, consider grouping them into separate sets. You can create additional sets at the end of this setup wizard by clicking Create Scenario.
default.financeTooltip: The finance type represents how you will pay for the vehicles selected. This finance type will assume default values based on your selection to calculate the finance costs. These can be changed later in the Financing tab.

default.subMessage: This information drives range and charging requirements determining EV and charger recommendations. Please fill out based on the vehicle you are using or your plans for the vehicle you are purchasing.
default.alertMessage: If vehicle usage exceeds 160 miles per day then your vehicles will need to be charged more than once per day (e.g. in the middle of the day).

default.subMessage: Think ahead to when you expect to charge your new EVs. Enter each daily window of time you expect to charge your vehicles and where, and we will recommend an ideal charger.
default.alertMessage: The most expensive time to charge is during peak times (M-F 4pm - 9pm). To ensure the highest savings, charge during off-peak hours.
